family.schneider-tower386sx.description: 386SX towers with a removable CPU card and System 40 and 70 variants.
family.schneider-tower386sx.history: The 386SX continued Schneider's modular tower design with a new processor card. The service manual, bearing a 1990 footer, covers System 40 and System 70 and presents the platform for DOS and OS/2. The video and I/O board retains links with the 286 VGA AT, while CPU, memory and real-time clock require their own documentation.
